p.src: 1  The LORD reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned among the cherubim. Let the earth be moved.

en: The LORD reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned among the cherubim. Let the earth be moved.
u.src: 1  The LORD reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned among the cherubim. Let the earth be moved.

p.src: 2  The LORD is great in Zion. He is high above all the peoples.

en: The LORD is great in Zion. He is high above all the peoples.
u.src: 2  The LORD is great in Zion. He is high above all the peoples.

p.src: 3  Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is Holy!

en: Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is Holy!
u.src: 3  Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is Holy!

p.src: 4  The King’s strength also loves justice. You establish equity. You execute justice and righteousness in Jacob.

en: The King’s strength also loves justice. You establish equity. You execute justice and righteousness in Jacob.
u.src: 4  The King’s strength also loves justice. You establish equity. You execute justice and righteousness in Jacob.

p.src: 5  Exalt the LORD our God. Worship at his footstool. He is Holy!

en: Exalt the LORD our God. Worship at his footstool. He is Holy!
u.src: 5  Exalt the LORD our God. Worship at his footstool. He is Holy!

p.src: 6  Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel was among those who call on his name. They called on the LORD, and he answered them.

en: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel was among those who call on his name. They called on the LORD, and he answered them.
u.src: 6  Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel was among those who call on his name. They called on the LORD, and he answered them.

p.src: 7  He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud. They kept his testimonies, the statute that he gave them.

en: He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud. They kept his testimonies, the statute that he gave them.
u.src: 7  He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud. They kept his testimonies, the statute that he gave them.

p.src: 8  You answered them, LORD our God. You are a God who forgave them, although you took vengeance for their doings.

en: You answered them, LORD our God. You are a God who forgave them, although you took vengeance for their doings.
u.src: 8  You answered them, LORD our God. You are a God who forgave them, although you took vengeance for their doings.

p.src: 9  Exalt the LORD, our God. Worship at his holy hill, for the LORD, our God, is holy!

en: Exalt the LORD, our God. Worship at his holy hill, for the LORD, our God, is holy!
u.src: 9  Exalt the LORD, our God. Worship at his holy hill, for the LORD, our God, is holy!
